spec.situation_desc: had their savings interest rate cut without noticing any letter
spec.vuln_cue: mentions their partner passed away recently

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Hannah speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Isla Varga. I’ve just noticed the interest rate on my savings has been cut, and I never saw a letter about it. I’m really unhappy.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry to hear that. Before I look at the account, could you tell me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s verified. I’ll check what I can see. Do you know roughly when you noticed the rate change?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Only this week. It’s gone from 4.1 per cent to 2.8, and I’ve had that account for years. My partner passed away recently, so I’ve had a lot on, but I’d still expect to be told.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand you’re unhappy about the rate change and that you didn’t notice a letter. I can log this as a complaint for you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, please do. I want to know why it changed and why I wasn’t told.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll record those concerns. You’ll hear back within five working days. That’s the timeframe I can give you today.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Will you be able to tell me what happened then?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The complaint will be reviewed, but I can’t say what the outcome will be. I’m not able to confirm the reason for the change from what we’ve discussed so far.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise, I’m logging a complaint about the savings rate being reduced and your concern that you didn’t receive or notice a letter. You’ll hear back within five working days, though I can’t promise an outcome. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you for explaining that, Isla. Is there anything else you’d like me to note in the complaint?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: All right. Thank you for calling Thistle Bank. Goodbye.
